verdict.rationale: Orrick publishes an AI-practice product of its own, the GenAI Policy Builder, a Tech Studio tool that drafts generative AI acceptable use policies. It also offers Tech Studio resources for integrating AI and has an Orrick Labs legal-tech unit, though the Labs evidence never mentions AI. Nothing in the evidence shows the firm disclosing how it uses AI in its own client service, such as named internal AI tools or its own AI-use policy. Missing for 10: disclosure of the firm's internal AI tools used on client matters, a published firm AI-use or governance policy, any evidence that Orrick Labs products are AI-based, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the firm publishes how it uses AI in client service — named tools, policies, or AI-practice products of its own — beyond a marketing mention

citations.quote: Create a draft generative AI acceptable use policy to help your company govern AI use by employees and contractors.
